title: Governance 2.0.1 control-plane promotion
objective: Settle Governance 2.0.1, Control Plane Profile 0.3.0, selected-future closure, bounded-caller contracts, and bot-bound dependency automation into one reviewable release.

work_items.desired_state: Governance schema release 2.0.1 expresses bounded callers, Practitioner Probes, veracity, orientation, probabilities, and selected-future closure.
entry_evidence: Enterprise Human-AI Practitioner Registry assessment and approved implementation plan.
completion_evidence: Every schema and mapped example passes the governance validator.
The selected-future closure contract represents all four substantive receipt families.

work_items.desired_state: Dependabot and Renovate exceptions combine complete branch grammar, exact pull-request author, governed target, and the ordinary validation path.

Official GitHub behavior identifies read-only tokens, Dependabot-scoped secrets, and default-branch security updates.
completion_evidence: Spoof, malformed-coordinate, wrong-target, partial-coordinate, Dependabot, and Renovate regression tests pass.
The repository-local branch checker binds complete branch grammar, exact bot author, and governed target together.
Dependency configuration and admitted ecosystem grammar advance together.

work_items.desired_state: The promoted governance release identifies its immutable commit, digest, branch coordinate, schema release, and downstream adoption path.
entry_evidence: All repository-local governance and automation checks pass.
completion_evidence: A governed release branch targets main and records its immutable PR-head or release coordinate.
The Machine Node replaces candidate zeros with the promoted commit and digest.
Downstream repositories validate against the promoted schema and workflow coordinates.

reentry_capsule.current_state: Governance 2.0.1 contracts and the bot-bound branch policy pass locally; release promotion and downstream immutable coordinates are settling.
reentry_capsule.next_safe_action: Run the full validation suite, promote through a release branch, and replace candidate provenance with immutable coordinates.
reentry_capsule.verification: Confirm 2.0.1 schema conformance, 0.3.0 profile binding, selected-future and automation digests, campaign markings, read-only workflow permissions, and passing regression tests.

retained_effects: Simulation closure remains definitive only within its selected future reality.
Automation identity requires both branch grammar and exact pull-request author.

consequential_questions: Which promoted coordinate should downstream repositories pin after every local suite is green?
Which future automation caller provides enough value to justify a new explicit grammar and author binding?
